name: Thai PBS Kingbridge Run 2026
short_description: Thai PBS Kingbridge Run 2026 is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at KINGSQUARE Community Mall on Rama 3 Road in Bangkok, over 21 km, 13 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Thai PBS Kingbridge Run 2026 is a running event on Sunday 6 December 2026 in Bangkok, organised by the Dr. Thiam Chokwatana Foundation and the Thai PBS Foundation. It offers a 21 km half marathon, a 13 km "super mini marathon" and a 5 km fun run. The RUNLAH listing places the start at KINGSQUARE Community Mall on Rama 3 Road; the official page does not describe the course.

core_facts.organizer: Dr. Thiam Chokwatana Foundation and Thai PBS Foundation

faqs.question: How much does the Thai PBS Kingbridge Run cost?
faqs.answer: The official Thai PBS page lists the 21 km half marathon at THB 999, the 13 km super mini marathon at THB 799 and the 5 km fun run at THB 599. Finishers in all distances receive a medal.

faqs.question: What distances does the Kingbridge Run offer?
faqs.answer: There are three distances: 21 km, 13 km and 5 km. The 13 km is longer than the usual 10 km mini marathon. The organisers can be reached through LINE @ThaiPBS or on 098-945-6568.
